content_data.meeting_title: Visual Identity & User Experience Review for 'Secure Ed-Connect'
agenda_items: Review of current brand mood boards and stylistic directions
Integration of security features into visual design language
Discussion on preliminary UI/UX wireframes for student and educator dashboards
Feedback session on proposed iconography and typography selections
Next steps for design iteration and client presentation
key_decisions: Incorporated subtle visual cues for security-enhanced elements, like lock icons on sensitive data fields.
action_items: Prepare a brief presentation on typography choices and their rationale for the next stakeholder meeting. (Designer: Elias Vance) - Due in +3 days
Create a comprehensive icon library reflecting the new visual identity. (Designer: Elias Vance) - Due in +7 days

memory_deletes.removed_item: Agreed to refine dashboard layouts to prioritize secure data display and intuitive navigation.
Selected a specific sans-serif font family for primary text, emphasizing readability.
